salary_details.institute post-doctoral fellow (ipdf): Rs. 67,000/- per month + House Rent Allowance (as per Institute rules). Candidates who have submitted their thesis and are awaiting the award of PhD Degree / provisional degree will be paid a reduced fellowship of Rs. 35,000/- per month plus HRA until the degree/provisional certificate is submitted.
salary_details.details: The IPDFs will be entitled to leaves and OPD medical facility as applicable to the PG students of the Institute, as laid down in the PG Manual.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed format application form (Annexure-I) from the official website or notification.
Compile a comprehensive list of publications.
Draft a detailed research plan for six months (maximum two pages).
Attach a scanned copy of your Ph.D. Degree certificate or Ph.D. Thesis submission receipt (if the Ph.D. Degree is yet to be awarded).
Send the completed application form in PDF format along with all required documents via email to [email protected] on or before October 14, 2026.
Ensure the subject line of the email reads exactly: "Application for the post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (EECS)".
important_instructions: Candidates who have completed their Ph.D. from IISER Bhopal are not allowed to apply for these IPDF positions. Ph.D. scholars who have submitted their thesis are eligible to apply, but must submit the provisional or degree certificate within six months from the date of appointment. It is mandatory for IPDFs to have a medical insurance policy (minimum of Rs. 1 lakh) in their name valid throughout the Fellowship period; no medical reimbursement is admissible. Besides research work, the selected IPDF is expected to assist in teaching course(s) as required by the Department. No accommodation will be provided to the IPDFs. No interim enquiries, correspondence, or communication of any sort will be entertained. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not entitle any candidate to be called for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

Compile a comprehensive list of publications. Draft a detailed research plan for six months (maximum two pages). content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal IPDF Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed their Ph.D. from IISER Bhopal are not allowed to apply for these IPDF positions. Ph.D. scholars who have submitted their thesis are eligible to apply, but must submit the provisional or degree certificate within six months from the date of appointment. It is mandatory for IPDFs to have a medical insurance policy (minimum of Rs. 1 lakh) in their name valid throughout the Fellowship period; no medical reimbursement is admissible. Besides research work, the selected IPDF is expected to assist in teaching course(s) as required by the Department. No accommodation will be provided to the IPDFs. No interim enquiries, correspondence, or communication of any sort will be entertained. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not entitle any candidate to be called for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.
